name: Synthesis of Co(ttpp) (more monitoring, proper Al2O3 pad)
plain_text_description:
Heat a 50 mL two-neck RBF in an oven (120 °C) for >1.5 h.
[15.12., RT 24.7°C, RH 30 %]
Assemble and fix a reflux condenser, a T-shaped connector, and a bubbler (filled with paraffin oil) at a Schlenk line.
Remove the RBF and quickly assemble it with a stir bar, rubber septum, and reflux condenser while it is still hot.
Evacuate (0.24 mbar), heat the bottom part of the reflux condenser and flask with a heat gun (250 °C). [Heating flask might not be necessary]
Backfill with N2
Add TAPP and TrBr (plastic spatula) quickly
Cycle with N2 slowly x3
Add Et3N
Add THF w/ double-tipped needle. [15:10] (black mixture)
Start stirring (350 rpm)
Cover the flask with Al foil.
→ 0.1 mL + CDCl3 500 µL, sonicate → 1H NMR M1
[16.12]
[08:15] → 0.1 mL + CDCl3 500 µL, sonicate → 1H NMR M2
Stop stirring. Close the N2 connection. Add CoCl2 quickly. Purge with N2 for 10 s. Close. Resume stirring.
Bubble with N2, 30 min.
Heat to reflux (85 °C, 1.25 atm) for 2 h
Cool down to RT.
→ 0.1 mL + CDCl3 500 µL, sonicate → 1H NMR M3 unfiltered → syringe filter → 1H NMR M3
Heat to reflux (85 °C, 1.25 atm) for 17 h
[17.12.]
Cool down to RT.
→ 0.1 mL + CDCl3 500 µL, sonicate → 1H NMR failed because of autosampler problem
Stir at RT for 24 h
→ 0.1 mL + CDCl3 500 µL, sonicate → syringe filter, rinsed with CDCl3 → 1H NMR M4
plain_text_observation:
[18.12. RT 24.2°C and RH 31%]
Add 12.5 mL of neutral alumina to a 25 mL frit funnel.
Attach the funnel to a vacuum filter adapter and a 250 mL RBF.
Wet the alumina with THF
Load the reaction mixture
Elute with THF (75 mL) and weak suction. (eluate: dark red to pale pink)  (The alumina pad became dark green at the top, pale green in the middle, and a little brown part at the bottom)
Add EtOH 25 mL to the eluate
Concentrate with rotovap to 25 mL. (dark brown precipitation)
Collect the solids by filtration with a filter paper (15A, ø 90 mm, tare: 0.51740 g), a glass funnel, a vacuum filter adapter, and a 100 mL RBF under suction. (filtrate: dark green solution)
Rinse with EtOH x3 and petroleum ether x2.
Dry filtrate with rotovap
[15.1.]
1H NMR-filtrate (DMSO)
Dry the residue under vacuum (diaphragm pump) for 1 h. [dark brown solid]
 0.26716 g  wt. on Filter paper.
Transfer to vial with label and tape (tare: 8.10142 g) --> 0.26232 g
The residue on filter paper → 1H NMR paper (CDCl3) [green solution]
1H NMR P_unfiltered (CDCl3) [dark red-brown suspension] → Syringe filter → 1H NMR_P [dark red-brown solution]
[15.1.]
1H NMR P (DMSO)
